findingDetails.title: The hub's own routing gate is recorded as failing, and no later run supersedes it after the gold was changed
findingDetails.scopeProof: all four files are in reviewScopeFiles; the contradiction is between artifacts inside the packet and the gold values were read from the frontmatter
findingDetails.case: an operator deciding whether to ship the hub opens benchmark/reports/README.md, sees the newest hub-routing row is 6 PASS, 1 FAIL with verdict FAIL, and blocks the release while the scenario file says the drift was resolved by operator decision and the router defer is now the correct answer
findingDetails.claim: The packet's newest recorded hub-routing run reports FAIL and an admission-check exit 1 against a gold the scenario file has since changed to defer, and no re-run supersedes it.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: read the whole hub-routing report, the whole benchmark index, the MT-H04 scenario and the playbook readiness clause. Checked whether a later run folder supersedes the FAIL: the index lists exactly two rows, the two-stage replay (PASS) and this hub-routing run (FAIL), and the replay covers six curated requests, not the seven playbook scenarios. Checked whether the report is framed as a historical record: benchmark/reports/README.md:19 says a run whose result changes gets a new folder, but no new folder exists.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the FAIL could be a deliberate historical record kept so the drift decision stays auditable, with the scenario gold change as the resolution; that explains why the old folder was not overwritten but not why the report finding 1 still says the gold was not edited, nor why the index carries no superseding row.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if the packet documents that the hub-routing FAIL is a closed historical record and that the admission check is re-run only at release time, with the scenario gold change as the accepted resolution.

findingDetails.title: The hub README's navigation table omits leaf-scopes.json, the file that decides which leaves are routable
